keySentence: Tom did not want to work today.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The fence was very long. Tom's friends were playing. He did not want to paint. Tom did not want to work today.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom stared at the long white fence that stretched on and on. He could hear his friends laughing and swimming in the river. The paint bucket felt heavy and the brush was old and worn. Tom did not want to work today but he had no choice at all. If he ran away, Aunt Polly would be very angry with him. Tom started thinking of a clever plan to escape his chore.
